class.name: FmodPcmStream
class.brief_description: Streams live PCM through an FMOD Studio programmer instrument.
class.description: Use one stream for each sound source. Godot pushes PCM on its main thread. FMOD reads it from a fixed native buffer. Studio controls routing, spatialization, effects, and volume.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes queued PCM and returns to buffering.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the latest setup or playback error.

method.name: get_overflow_count
method.description: Returns the number of old frames removed to make space.

method.name: get_queued_frames
method.description: Returns the number of PCM frames waiting for FMOD.

method.name: get_rebuffer_count
method.description: Returns how many times playback returned to buffering.

method.name: get_underrun_count
method.description: Returns how many audio reads did not have enough PCM.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Creates the PCM sound and Studio event. The event must contain a looping asynchronous programmer instrument. The stream accepts one or two channels.

method.name: is_buffering
method.description: Returns whether the stream is waiting for its start threshold.

method.name: is_started
method.description: Returns whether the Studio event was started.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the stream owns a valid Studio event.

method.name: push_pcm
method.description: Queues PCM and returns the number of frames added. Stereo samples must alternate between left and right.

method.name: set_distance_scale
method.description: Sets the scale used when converting Godot positions to FMOD positions.

method.name: set_node_attributes
method.description: Copies a Node2D or Node3D position to the Studio event.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops and releases the Studio event.

members.member: Whether the stream is waiting for more PCM.
